local_stack_after.desc: Orchestrator-owned. Scratch copy of the repo at HEAD (src, agent, reto-01, web, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.dom.json, package.json; node_modules symlinked), web/dist built in the repo with `bun run build:web` and copied. Fake LLM + production-mode server serving web/dist. 0 tokens.
local_stack_after.fake_llm: FAKE_LLM_PORT=4023 bun .qa/evidence/03-chat-web-api-sse-y-despliegue/seeds/03-fake-llm.ts (routing: 'casos hay' -> listar; 'QA-TEXTO' -> text; 'QA-LENTO' -> 4 s per call; 'QA-402|500|503' -> provider status; 'Sí, envía X' -> simular_envio confirmado; 'Cancela el envío de X' -> text; any message naming several case ids -> leer/mapear/generar/armar per case, in order)
local_stack_after.server: cd $QA_SCRATCH/after && PORT=3123 NODE_ENV=production LLM_PROVIDER=falso LLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4023 LLM_MODEL=modelo-falso LLM_API_KEY=clave-falsa-qa-centinela LLM_FALLBACK_ENABLED=false ACCESS_CODE=codigo-local-de-prueba ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET=<synthetic 40 chars> FECHA_EJECUCION=2026-09-03 TZ_NEGOCIO=America/Bogota LOG_LEVEL=info bun --env-file=/dev/null src/server.ts

local_stack_before.desc: Same server, but web/dist built from the pre-refactor front: `git archive b7446861 web package.json tsconfig.json | tar -x -C $QA_SCRATCH/before`, copy src/, agent/ and reto-01/ from HEAD, node_modules symlinked, `bun --bun vite build` there. src/ is HEAD (backend diff of the phase is one preflight string). Port 3124, same fake LLM.

variants.3126: scratch copy whose fixtures add a synthetic case with a 60-char slug copied from co-industrias-delta (T08); seed .qa/evidence/05-front-web-por-features-e-identidad-de-marca/seeds/05-T08-slug-largo.sh
variants.4043: fake LLM with FAKE_FORCE_STATUS=402 behind server 3127 (T01a errores y avisos)

remote.access_code: read in memory from .qa/render.token (gitignored); never echo, never write to evidence

gotchas: NEW_SESSIONS_PER_HOUR=5 per IP: browser runners set a distinct synthetic X-Forwarded-For per context (server trusts one proxy hop)
QA-500/402 runs leave health 'no disponible' until one successful turn (send QA-TEXTO)
the before copy needs agent/prompt.md or every turn fails

tests.name: Compuertas de humo: check, test, build web y demo
tests.recipe: bun run check ; bun test ; bun run build:web ; bun run demo.ts (logs in .qa/logs/05-gate-*.log)

tests.name: Flujos de D-116 en local, antes y después del refactor (LLM falso)
tests.recipe: Run the same Playwright script against 3124 (before) then 3123 (after), 1280x720 and 375x667: acceso (wrong code, right code); estado vacío (tarjetas de caso / chips); 'procesa el caso ec-corp-andina' -> tool cards, progreso, tarjeta de resultado; 'Sí, envía ec-corp-andina' via confirmation card -> envío simulado; panel de casos; archivos: lista, descarga, vista previa enmascarada, Esc; Nueva sesión dialog (Seguir, Esc, focus); errores y avisos: 'QA-402' and server 3127 (402); at each step capture role/name snapshot of main regions and the request log (method+path+status). Diff before vs after ignoring brand-only text and CSS.
asserts: same request sequence before/after per flow
same visible functional text (tool names, states, counts 13/1/1 BLOQUEADO)
human_checks: visible differences are only the intended brand and card changes

tests.name: CI verde y ensayo de la sección 11 del PRD en el link público con el modelo real
tests.recipe: Bundle check: GET / on remote -> asset hashes == local web/dist of HEAD. Playwright 1280x720 on remote: access with code from .qa/render.token (served in memory, never printed); send TEXTO_PREFLIGHT.mensajeGuion (case ec-corp-andina, 'No envíes nada todavía'); wait end; result card counts; confirm no simular_envio in SSE; then click Cancelar envío. Screenshots per step. ONE real-model run.
human_checks: CI run on GitHub Actions green for HEAD (gh not installed; human confirms)

tests.name: Encabezado angosto con logo a 375x667 y 320x568
tests.recipe: After access, at 375x667 and 320x568: measure header line 1 (logo img box, divider, title) getBoundingClientRect: same top row, no overlap logo/title, logo height 24px, title font-family Outfit and 16px computed; line 2 single row with text-overflow ellipsis; screenshot header.

tests.name: Chips en píldora con Montserrat a 375x667 con historial
tests.recipe: At 375x667 process one case so history exists; measure chips container: distinct row tops <= 2, scrollWidth == clientWidth on container and document; computed font-family Montserrat and document.fonts.check; screenshot.

tests.name: Acceso con código errado
tests.recipe: Fresh context, wrong code + Enter: message inside the white card (rect containment), computed color == --error-texto token value, element in aria-live/role=alert region or aria-describedby, document.activeElement is the input, aria-invalid=true; contrast ratio of message vs card background computed; screenshot.

tests.name: Acceso mientras verifica el código
tests.recipe: page.route POST access endpoint delayed 2 s; type right code, press Enter then click the pill twice and Enter again during the delay; capture pill text, aria-busy/disabled, screenshot mid-delay; count access POSTs.
asserts: pill shows busy text and disabled/aria-busy

tests.name: Primera carga en frío: encabezado sin salud ni fecha todavía
tests.recipe: Local: page.route /api/health and /api/config delayed 8 s; screenshot header at 1280 and 375 before they resolve; check no orphan dot/separator element visible with empty text and no empty gap box. Remote: real cold start only after 15 min idle (spin-down); the run checks whether the service is cold when it starts and captures the first paint if so.
asserts: no visible empty status dot or separator while health/date are pending

tests.name: Nombre largo del modelo a 320x568
tests.recipe: Server 3125 with a 64-char synthetic LLM_MODEL; at 320x568 after access: model prefix element hidden (display none / zero width), model text has text-overflow ellipsis and scrollWidth > clientWidth, line 2 one row, no document horizontal scroll; screenshot.
asserts: line 2 one row with a long model name

tests.name: Tarjeta de caso con slug de 60 caracteres a 375x667 y 1280x720
tests.recipe: Scratch fixtures copy adds casos/co-<57 chars> copied from co-industrias-delta (seed script); empty state shows its card; at both viewports: card rect within its grid column, client and slug computed overflow-wrap anywhere, card scrollWidth == clientWidth, no document horizontal scroll; screenshot.

tests.name: Interrumpir un turno en local, antes y después (Detener, recarga, Nueva sesión)
tests.recipe: On both: send 'procesa el caso co-industrias-delta QA-LENTO'; at 6 s Detener -> no 'En curso', composer enabled, GET session ocupada=false; again, at 6 s reload -> timeline reconciles, no stuck card; again, at 6 s Nueva sesión -> dialog behavior and resulting state. Record DOM text + requests and diff before/after.
asserts: same end state before/after for each of the 3 interruptions

tests.name: Interrumpir un turno en el link público con el modelo real
tests.recipe: Remote, same session as T01b after it ends: send 'procesa el caso co-industrias-delta', press Detener after the first tool card; then a second short turn and reload during it. Compare end state with T09a. Real-model turns: 2 short partial turns.

tests.name: Cortar /api/config después de entrar (WR-03)
tests.recipe: page.route('**/api/config') abort after access; empty state: role=status contains the exact WR-03 text; chips and composer enabled and send works; unroute; wait for retry -> grid of case cards appears; screenshots before/after.

tests.name: El neón nunca como texto o control sobre superficie clara
tests.recipe: On access screen, loading screen, chat (1280 and 375) and with keyboard focus walked over every focusable: for every element whose computed color, border-color, outline-color or background-color equals the neon (#6DFD8C / rgb(109,253,140)), resolve the nearest opaque ancestor background and report it; also inside the white access card check focus outline color == --acento.
asserts: every neon use sits on the teal background
human_checks: confirm by eye on the screenshots

tests.name: Revisión visual de la identidad de marca
tests.recipe: Screenshots: access, loading, empty state with 2x2 card grid at 1280x720, 1 column at 375x667, chat with history, result and confirmation cards, file preview; document.fonts list (Outfit, Montserrat loaded from /fuentes), favicon link resolves 200 same-origin, document.title; no third-party font/asset requests.
human_checks: looks like Periferia IT Group, chat-first, light, per 05-UI-SPEC.md

tests.name: Cadena de suministro de los 5 devDependencies y atribución de marca
tests.recipe: For each devDependency added in phase 5 (git diff b7446861..HEAD -- package.json): read node_modules/<pkg>/package.json scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall absent); `npm view <pkg>@<ver> time --json` (or registry fetch) for the publish time vs install commit time 36727e4; bun audit; grep SOLUCION.md for the brand attribution line.
asserts: each version >= 7 days old at install
human_checks: accept that (b) has no automated guard, or ask for a test

tests.name: Vista previa abierta mientras el agente procesa varios casos (WR-01)
tests.recipe: Process ec-corp-andina first; then send 'procesa los casos ec-corp-andina co-industrias-delta QA-LENTO' — wait until A files exist, open 'Ver formulario.pdf' of A; while the agent moves to B: dialog stays visible (outside the collapsible), A block not collapsed, B progress advances; close with Esc -> focus returns to that 'Ver' button.

tests.name: 401 en /api/config tras código aceptado (IN-01) y chips/tarjetas durante la recarga de sesión (IN-07)
tests.recipe: (a) page.route('**/api/config') fulfill 401 with the server's JSON error after a successful access POST: message shows as system notice above the field, input not aria-invalid, no field error text. (b) With history, page.route('**/api/sessions/*') delayed 3 s and reload: during hydration chips, case cards and 'procesar de nuevo' are disabled; enabled after.

tests.name: Regresión: preflight local con el texto nuevo de la sección 11
